notice.edit: Ran {{tools}}. Editing takes back the reply, not what the tools did.
notice.regenerate: Ran {{tools}}. What they did stays, and a new reply may run them again.
notice.edited: Your message is back in the composer. What {{tools}} did was not undone.

escalation.lowConfidence: Answered by a larger model because the first answer wasn't confident enough.
escalation.timeout: Answered by another model because the first one took too long.
escalation.error: Answered by another model because the first one failed.
escalation.invalidOutput: Answered by another model because the first answer couldn't be used.
escalation.other: Answered by another model than the first one tried.

retry.empty: The model was asked again because its first reply was empty.
retry.truncated: The model was asked again because its first reply was cut off.
retry.contentFilter: The model was asked again because its provider's content filter stopped the first reply.
retry.format: The model was asked again because its first reply wasn't in the expected format.
retry.contextTooLong: The model was asked again because the conversation was too long for it.
retry.other: The model was asked again because its first reply couldn't be used.

guardrail.inputBlock: A safety check stopped your message ({{type}}).
guardrail.inputRedact: A safety check removed part of your message before the agent saw it ({{type}}).
guardrail.inputWarn: A safety check flagged your message ({{type}}).
guardrail.outputBlock: A safety check withheld the answer ({{type}}).
guardrail.outputRedact: A safety check removed part of the answer ({{type}}).
guardrail.outputReprompt: A safety check sent the answer back to be rewritten ({{type}}).
guardrail.outputWarn: A safety check flagged the answer ({{type}}).
guardrail.other: A safety check acted on this turn ({{type}}: {{phase}}, {{action}}).
